item.title: Version 0.4.23
item.description: Button hover and press feedback now covers the full control. Split chevrons and overflow menus have larger, consistent targets. Quick Action and dictation use consistent footer spacing. Refine saves changes directly to the current note or todo. Run Workflow appears before Open in App.

item.title: Version 0.4.24
item.description:
Home now lets you type or dictate a draft and save it as a note or todo. The pickup list puts sessions waiting for your response first.
Long meeting transcripts open faster. Meeting checkpoints, audio processing, and waveform updates do less work.
Codex dictation cleanup can finish longer rewrites. Codex and Claude text processing now ask for one finished result.

item.title: Version 0.4.25
item.description:
Saving a note or todo now updates its library entry directly. Large libraries refresh faster, and meeting recovery and Diagnostics use less work and memory.
Codex processing keeps valid responses after a reconnect. Standalone trash controls now use a shared neutral icon.
This update also improves speech task cancellation, sync recovery, and shared search and permission controls.

item.title: Version 0.4.26
item.description: - Home shows sessions that need attention, running work, and recent captures. Respond opens the linked session without losing the note or todo. - The sidebar shows session status in text. Captures keep their session pane when you return, and the Sessions menu switches between linked runs. - Meeting recordings checkpoint with less disk work and recover more reliably after interruptions. - Codex CLI timeout diagnostics distinguish startup, authentication, and response processing.
